category_title: Mature students with depression and insomnia focused on vocational progression
scenario_title: Procedural error during a cooking task
minimal_context: Colin is participating in a specialized cookery course where he needs to chop onions and add them to a recipe at the right time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Colin, please chop the onions and put them in at the right time for the recipe.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not sure when they go in... I have a fear of failure and I'm worried the other students will laugh at me if I make a mistake.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Colin, just follow the instructions on the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Colin looks down at the onions, feeling embarrassment about asking for help. He stares blankly, exhausted from severe insomnia and depression.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Colin, I am talking to you. Why are you just standing there?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You really showed me up! I didn't realise you were talking to me. That done it for me. I'm leaving and I'm never going back.
